caps.comment_max_width: Sponsor has not set a width cap; null = no cap. Layers count blocks (founding blocks + joining block + stacked blocks). Heads are per block. Width is the stream width d.

comment: Inputs for bert_lifecycle.py, the Frankenstein lifecycle driver (method frozen by the sponsor, 2026-11-27; see FRANKENSTEIN_METHOD.md). Every cap and budget is an input here, never hard-coded in the driver. Scores are gaps in percent on the fixed validation set (val_seed 20261116, 200 problems, 10 cities); lower is better.

evolution.comment_scaled_rate: Open and free evolution use per-gene rate = target_nudges_per_child / n_genes (the mutation scaling rule, sponsor 2026-11-27: ~25 nudges per child at any genome size, never a flat 10 percent). Seam, parent, stack and appendix stages keep the proven nominal 0.10 on their small mutable sets.

founding.comment_gens: Split evenly into the engine runner's phase A and phase B budgets.

growth.comment_appendix: Recorded reading of the sponsor's 'stack skinny (like 1/4 size)': the appendix block's feed-forward width = round(fraction x current backend block's feed-forward width), minimum 1. The step 3 stack block keeps the proven shape (feed-forward width = stream width).

termination.comment_max_cycles: null = no cycle limit; the lifecycle stops on a cap hit or on a full cycle with no improvement (step 12). Set an integer as a safety bound if wanted.
termination.comment_tolerance: Champion rule (step 13): among champions whose gap is within this many points of the best gap, the smallest genome is the kept champion. The tolerance is a config input because exact float ties between different networks do not occur.

widen.comment: Step 5 of the lifecycle (added 2026-11-27, sponsor ruling: what was just done with Frankenstein is the logic for evolution). Net2WiderNet split-widen of the whole network between the backend Frankenstein and open evolution: stream x2, every FFN x2, every head count x2, decoder widened with the stream, attn_scale halved. The no-noise widen must pass the exact preservation gate (identical tours, gap unchanged) before noise is applied.
widen.comment_noise: Gaussian noise added after splitting to the new copies' synapse weights only (original copies stay exact). std 0.003 is the value both completed lines ran (the 0.03 run drifted +12.21 points and was rejected by the sponsor). The noise seed comes from the line's seed family (seed_base offset +40).
